description.short: Non-prod Sales agent preview for extensibility testing. Not for production.
description.full:
**NON-PRODUCTION — TEST ONLY. Do not use in production or with real customer data.**

This is an isolated PREVIEW build of the Sales agent used to develop and validate extensibility (custom tools, actions, and knowledge) through a proper software development lifecycle (Dev → UAT → SIT) before the same extensions are applied to the production Sales agent.

- **Environment:** ${{TEAMSFX_ENV}}

**What you do with this package:**
- Extend this agent with your own external tools (API plugins / MCP / connected agents) and knowledge using the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.
- Point those tools at the matching non-production Dynamics environment using the `env/.env.*` variables.
- Sideload to an individual user or publish to your test tenant to validate the integration in isolation, without touching the production Sales agent.

Manage per-environment values (Dynamics environment ID, endpoints, client IDs) in the `env/.env.<environment>` files so the same template can produce a separate agent for each stage of your lifecycle.
